summary: Prepared full independence from the Codex/Sites pipeline on the owner's instruction that Codex may be cancelled. docs/DEPLOY_HANDOVER_FACTS.md had established that the Sites production Worker and D1 live in an OpenAI-side Cloudflare account the owner cannot reach, so independence means a new owner-owned production plus a data exit. All three pieces now exist and are verified: GET /api/admin/export (admin-only, recent-auth, durable ledger tables only — sessions and challenges deliberately excluded) returns the full state and fails closed unauthenticated; scripts/import-export.mjs converts that JSON to INSERT OR FAIL SQL, round-trip-verified against a fresh database carrying migrations 0000-0005 with exact count parity on real data; and wrangler.owner.jsonc deploys the vinext build to the owner's already-authenticated Cloudflare account, validated by a successful dry-run (2.1MB bundle, 115 assets, DB and ASSETS bindings resolved) with workers_dev pinned false so the worker has no public URL until a Cloudflare-Access-guarded custom domain is attached per docs/OWNER_DEPLOY_RUNBOOK.md. Image generation stays on Codex per the owner. The export endpoint must ride the next Sites deployment so the exit hatch exists in production while Sites still works. Lint, typecheck, build and 82 tests pass.

blockers.description: A separate owner-run session implements Discord login inside the OTOMO CHAIN 7 repository; its server side is committed and deployed with the feature disabled while its web side was still uncommitted. Writing there from this session would destroy concurrent work, and that session's git housekeeping has already deleted an untracked directory created here, so generated assets are produced outside the repository until they are committed.
blockers.resolution_required: Confirm the OTOMO CHAIN work is committed and its export shape final before this session adapts dashboard reconciliation or edits that repository.

blockers.description: Stable Next and Miniflare still require Sharp 0.34.5, which npm audit flags for inherited libvips advisories. The built Worker has no Sharp or libvips import and the application has no untrusted image-processing path, so the documented owner-only non-reachable exception remains in force.
blockers.resolution_required: Upgrade when stable Next and Cloudflare or Miniflare officially support patched Sharp; reassess immediately if image upload or server-side untrusted processing is added.
